thread:
maya: Quick postmortem follow-up — the delayed metering ingestion we saw last Thurs caused ~150 invoices to show inflated token counts. Finance wants clear owners and ETA for corrected invoices + credits. Root window was ~2026-03-04 03:05-04:28 UTC (ingest consumer lag). cc @devin @zach @elaine :eyes:

 devin: Got it. I'm checking the ingest consumer group logs now. Initial hunch: intermittent Kafka consumer lag + a retry storm. Will confirm the message timestamps and whether tokens were duplicated on write.

 zach: If it's duplicates on write, we'll need a reaggregation backfill. Estimated effort: 2 devs * 3 days to run backfill and validate. Who owns the go/no-go for running that on prod spike windows? @ops-monitor?

 ops-monitor: ops-monitor: FYI we saw spike in consumer lag at 03:12 UTC, broker CPU peaked. No ongoing alerts now. We can schedule a controlled backfill but need a maintenance window and throttling plan.

 maya: Action list proposal:
 - A1: Root-cause confirm + concrete repro steps (owner: @devin) — due 2026-03-06 EOD
 - A2: Backfill reaggregation plan + safety gates (owner: @zach) — due 2026-03-09
 - A3: Generate corrected invoices & credit memos (owner: @elaine/finance) — target 2026-03-12
 - A4: Add recurring metering health query + Pager alert (owner: @devin) — due 2026-03-07
 - A5: Customer comms draft + signoff (owner: @elaine, legal looped) — due 2026-03-11
 Anyone object or want different owners?

 elaine: OK to own invoices. Need CSV of affected accounts + corrected token deltas. Also need list of credits to apply and a verification sample. Finance prefers credit memos, not manual refunds.

 devin: I'll attach the query and sample output. Example of inflated records:
 ```
 query result row:
 customer_id: 3489, event_ts: 2026-03-04T03:15:12Z, recorded_tokens: 12000, dedup_tokens: 6000
 ```
 That dedup_tokens field is what we need to recompute. Raw consumer logs show duplicates with the same message_id written twice.

 zach: For the backfill we'll run reaggregation on a snapshot of raw events and write corrected aggregates to the billing datastore. Plan: run job on staging, run verification diff (counts before/after) for a sample of 50 accounts.

 ops-monitor: Throttle plan: run backfill with max parallelism=4, rate limit to 5k events/sec. We'll reserve the non-peak window 02:00-06:00 UTC next Tue.

 maya: Noted. Two recurring incident items we flagged in the postmortem: (1) consumer lag due to broker CPU spikes when retries pile up, (2) lack of an end-to-end metering reconciliation alert. Both need medium-term fixes. We should track them as recurring incident patterns.

 devin: I'll open a follow-up ticket for consumer retry-hardening (id: BI-3421) and attach logs + repro. Also adding a metric: dedup_rate = duplicated_messages / total_ingested over 5m.

 elaine: Finance note: estimated customer impact — 150 invoices, mean adjustment $42, total ~$6.3k. We'll prepare customer comms template for credits. Legal approves template; pinged them.

 maya: OK locking owners. I'll create a single Kanban board ticket listing A1-A5 with owners and due dates and tag everyone. If anyone can't meet ETA, flag by EOD tomorrow.

 zach: One more ask — can we add a quick sanity test for the post-aggregation step? e.g., checksum of event_ids count == aggregated_count. If mismatch, reject write.

 devin: Good idea. Adding to A2. Also adding an automated nightly reconcile that samples top-500 accounts.

 billing-bot: Notice: Created ticket BI-3421 for retry-hardening, assigned to devin. Created ticket BI-3422 for backfill plan, assigned to zach.

 maya: Thanks all. I'll follow up with the Kanban link and draft timeline. :thumbsup:
